body.p: This listing of claims reflects all claim amendments and replaces all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application. Material to be inserted is in bold and underline, and material to be deleted is in strikeout or in [[double brackets]] if the deletion would be difficult to see.

br.br:
1. (Currently amended) A system for a vehicle, comprising:an input;
an output;
a first software component for use in configuring operation of a second software component via a proxy and stub interface;
a non-transitory memory component storing software components and comprising:a first memory space comprising thestoring a first software component, a proxy software component, and an activity monitor software component; and
a second memory space comprising thestoring a second software component and a stub software component, the first software component configured to interact with the second software component via the proxy software component and the stub software component; and
at least one processor for executing software components stored on the first and second memory spaces such that the first software component is configured to perform a polling event of a sensor component stored in the first memory space to obtain a speed reading of the vehicle, perform a comparison event to compare the speed
Application Filing Date: May 28, 2021
reading to a target speed, generate a command for engine output torque based on the comparison, and send the command to the proxy software component as a command event, and the proxy software component is configured to send the command event to the stub software component,wherein the activity monitor software component is arranged when executed to:
cause the input to monitor the polling event, the comparison event, and the command eventa first event associated with the first software component;
cause the input to monitor a second event associated with the proxy software component, wherein the second event includes a command event at the proxy software component;
assess compliance of the first and secondpolling, comparison, and command events with a schedule of events, wherein assessing compliance includes checking anorder and/or atiming of the first and secondpolling, comparison, and command events; and
cause the output to generate an error message in response to assessed non- compliance with the schedule of events, the error message configured to be displayed, detectable by a diagnostic tool, or used to troubleshoot an error.
2. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the schedule of events includes an expected timing and/or order of the polling, comparison, and command events.
3. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising a data store partitioned into the first memory space and the second memory space.
Application Filing Date: May 28, 2021
4. (Original) The system of claim 1, further comprising a first data store comprising the first memory space and a second data store comprising the second memory space.
5. (Cancelled)
6. (Currently amended) The system of claim [[5]]1, wherein the vehicle system is a cruise control system.
7. (Original) The system of claim 5, wherein the second software component comprises a drivetrain component.
8. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first software component comprises a logic component arranged to generate [[a]]the command event to control the second software component based on an input event.
9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the input event comprises [[a]]the sensor reading obtained from [[a]]the sensor component.
10. (Previously presented) The system of claim 9, wherein the sensor component is a wheel speed sensor component.
11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 9, wherein the input event is obtained in response to [[a]]the polling event initiated by the logic component.
Application Filing Date: May 28, 2021
12. (Cancelled)
13. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, further comprising a troubleshooting component arranged to treat [[an]]the error in response to receiving the error message.
14. (Original) A vehicle comprising the system of claim 4.
15. (Cancelled)
16. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1[[5]], wherein the corresponding stub software component is arranged to route the command event to a powertrain component.
17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 16[[5]], wherein the powertrain component is an engine control unit, and further wherein any torque demands received are used to configure a motor to output a desired output torque.
18. (Previously presented) The system of claim 1, wherein the proxy software component is arranged to marshal additional command events and route each command event to a target location on another memory space.
